---
title: "Before ethics or governance submission"
---

**Pause point:** Immediately before submitting an ethics, governance, site-authorisation or amendment package.

**Prevents:** Contradictory documents, unmanaged participant or community risks, unclear data flows, and delays caused by avoidable omissions.

**Use:** Read-do.

## Critical checks

- [ ] I am using the current local form, policy, templates and submission route.
- [ ] The protocol, application, recruitment material, participant information, consent process, instruments and data plan describe the same study.
- [ ] Recruitment is fair, feasible and appropriate to power relationships, vulnerability, inclusion and exclusion.
- [ ] Participant experience is clear from first contact through consent, participation, withdrawal, follow-up and results communication.
- [ ] Risks, burdens, benefits and safeguards are proportionate and described without minimising uncertainty.
- [ ] Every data movement, storage location, access role, linkage, sharing arrangement, retention period and disposal action has been mapped.
- [ ] Anonymity, de-identification, confidentiality and privacy are distinguished accurately.
- [ ] Payments, withdrawal, complaints, distress, adverse events, incidental findings and protocol deviations are addressed where relevant.
- [ ] Team roles, training, conflicts of interest, site permissions and external agreements are documented.
- [ ] Every document has a controlled version and date, and a second person has checked the complete package for contradictions.

## Stop condition

Do not submit while documents materially contradict one another, a data flow is unexplained, or a foreseeable material risk has no proportionate response.

## Evidence to retain

Keep the exact submitted package, version register, data-flow map, permissions, training records, submission receipt, review correspondence and final approval conditions.

::: {.callout-warning title="Check locally"}
Only the responsible ethics, governance or review body can determine whether the submission is complete or approve the work.
:::
